transcript.answer: Otto was planned for Cloud Run in europe-north1 (issue #27), chosen so the service would sit in the same region as the Vertex model. That plan was never built. Otto was deployed to the shared GKE cluster `n8n-cluster` in europe-west1, which is where the api, web and MongoDB run, and the deployment spec records this divergence. Issue #27 was closed as superseded. The region choice also lost its premise. Measurements on 2026-10-16 showed europe-north1 serves only the Gemini 2.5 models (pro, flash, flash-lite), which retire on 2026-10-20, and no 3.x or 4 model. The current models are served from the `eu` multi-region, so the model runs on Vertex AI's `eu` multi-region instead. ADR-003 (PR #416) records this and supersedes the unwritten ADR-001. The sources don't give a separate reason for choosing the shared GKE cluster over Cloud Run.
